name: Pennsylvania Dental Group
description: A Philadelphia general dentistry practice offering checkups, cleanings, and restorative care.

hero.headline: Pennsylvania Dental Group
hero.sub: Checkups, cleanings, and restorative care with a team that explains every step.

items: Restorative dentistry including fillings and crowns
Cosmetic consultations for whitening and smile improvements
New patients welcome, most insurance accepted
Modern equipment and a comfort-first exam room
Clear treatment plans explained before any work begins

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Pennsylvania Dental Group focuses on the basics done well: prevention, clear communication, and treatment scoped to what a patient actually needs.
Small issues get caught early, so visits stay simple and predictable.

items: Book an appointment and get a plain explanation of what the visit involves.
No surprise upsells -- treatment plans are reviewed before anything is scheduled.
A calm, modern office designed to make routine visits easy.

feature.heading: Preventive care that catches problems early
feature.text: Regular cleanings and exams cost less than emergency work down the road -- and hurt a lot less too.

spotlight.heading: Restorative and cosmetic options
spotlight.text: From a simple filling to a smile consultation, treatment is scoped to what you actually need.
